scope: Original20-point research; qualification results. Unqualified items remain candidates, not completed optimizations.
measurement_limits: Synthetic offline fixtures, no cloud calls. Memory figures are peak traced Python allocations, not RSS or whole-scan RAM. CPU/wall improvements apply to the measured request/read workloads.

points.title: Reduce remaining native cold-start proof construction
points.decision: Remaining proof construction still dominates cold startup. Existing authenticated bootstrap cache is enabled. Further changes affect live admission and require corruption/rebind and cold-job qualification; no new guard change retained.

points.title: Evaluate only invalidated dependencies during progressive rebuilds
points.decision: Current implementation already batches durable envelopes and uses adaptive report cadence. It still seals/evaluates cumulative snapshots. Dependency reuse needs correct late-scope/status/version invalidation; no incomplete-result reuse introduced.

points.title: Extend secret detector cohorts to remaining per-source collectors
points.decision: Lambda cohorts and AWS/GCP logs and archive batches already exist. Further source families retain native source/deadline/private-evidence requirements; no new collector cohort qualified in this wave.

points.title: Publish query indexes that eliminate full finding scans
points.decision: Principal prefiltering and bounded finding-page selection already exist. Publication postings require review-overlay/default/legacy-manifest parity and publication-cost measurements; no new format introduced.

points.title: Stream full report and Markdown downloads during publication
points.decision: Publisher already serializes ordinary chunks once and overlaps bounded uploads. Full JSON/Markdown streaming needs artifact and download byte parity plus CPU/memory qualification; no new streaming serializer retained.

points.title: Allow concurrent readers of leased Trivy DB generations
points.decision: Shared-reader lease prototype preserved locally. Normal native admission rejected changed peaso/trivy_database_20261021.py in provider_group_install_20261021._preflight. Admitted production source restored; no guard bypass or unqualified memory/concurrency expansion.

points.title: Reuse image analysis for exact image and scanner identities
points.decision: aws_image_vulnerability_native_20261021.collect_native already has scan-local complete image cache and index-child result cache bound to DB lease, with native revalidation and per-resource attribution.

points.title: Qualify the bounded image transfer pipeline across providers
points.decision: aws_package_content_indicators._download_image_layers already overlaps at most two transfers, preserves descriptor ordering and validates layer sizes/digests. Not duplicated.

points.title: Bound collector pending work as well as active threads
points.decision: AWS active pools are bounded and completed_reads consumes completions except when global resource caps require order. Bounded submission must preserve that cap order and dependency progress; not claimed as a measured new win.

points.title: Tune concurrency by throttling domain and observed service latency
points.decision: Requests already has shared attempt/deadline budgets, isolated content/activity pools, and adaptive IAM report pacing. Further tuning requires real throttle/latency distributions; no blind concurrency/retry increases.

points.title: Pipeline independent per-resource enrichment reads
points.decision: Azure embedding and GCP hydration pools already run child work concurrently. AWS _enrich remains serial for some resource families; a generic nested pool would risk global budgets and native receipts. No new enrichment path qualified.

points.title: Reuse immutable reachability indexes across API requests
points.decision: Batch/matrix/grid already share one validated index inside a request. Cross-request cache would retain native inventories and needs byte budgets and fresh authorization/binding tests before qualification.

points.title: Compile repeated network rule values once per model
points.decision: Complete AWS matrix CPU improved from0.0025375 to0.001597seconds, but peak traced allocation rose272346 to300835bytes. Other providers had little benefit. Candidate reverted; no parsed-network cache shipped.

points.title: Cache expensive privilege graph query results by immutable graph
points.decision: Use bounded top-page selection rather than retaining a query-result cache. Original traversal/confidence/order and exact totals remain; small graphs and deep pages retain full-sort path. No new persistent graph cache.

points.title: Replace entry-count-only graph caches with shared byte budgets
points.decision: Existing graph derivative views are already lazy. Byte-based eviction needs representative multi-tenant reuse data to prevent repeated decoding/index rebuilds; reducing cache entry counts blindly was not adopted.

points.title: Stream TAR decompression and overlap bounded archive scan windows
points.decision: ZIP/TAR detector windows already batch. TAR gzip expansion still materializes bytes; streaming requires native source qualification and exact expansion/trailing-data/partial-positive behavior. No new parser shipped.

points.title: Extend strict validated joins beyond the optimized SW46 module
points.decision: Strict SW46 MemoIndex joins are already integrated. Other native helper families need full-stage profiles before selecting a new strict join; no validation/duplicate/error-order relaxation.

points.title: Extend evaluation-local metadata preparation to other finding emitters
points.decision: Evaluation-local engine finding factory already integrated. Removing a redundant API metadata copy produced -0.72% to+2.68% CPU changes and under0.05% allocation change across full30k-row HTTP requests; restored predecessor code. A later selection-local service-label cache was also rejected after actual-predecessor ABBA: native CPU change -0.68% to+2.45%; legacy/analysis requests3.19–9.69%slower. No cache/decorator retained.

points.title: Read only the control fields needed by worker polling
points.decision: Fresh narrow control reads in SQLite/DynamoDB; worker uses these with existing-store fallback. DynamoDB remains strongly consistent and checks TTL. Poll interval, leases, cancellation and full job reads remain available.

points.title: Page scan history in the database instead of loading all tenant jobs
points.decision: DynamoStore.jobs still loads/sorts all tenant history. Database cursor pagination needs a new access path and coordinated API/consumer contract; no silent truncation or weaker consistency introduced.
